description.value: 97 Street Pub is a full-service pub and sports bar attached to the Best Western Plus Kelowna Hotel & Suites on Highway 97 North, featuring 16 screens, a dining room, and a daily-open patio with a wide selection of local Okanagan beer, wine, and a broad food menu. The pub hosts regular live entertainment on Saturday nights and offers delivery through DoorDash. Its location near the mall and supermarkets makes it a convenient stop for visitors passing through the north end of Kelowna.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms the pub operates at 2400 Hwy 97 North, Kelowna, connected to the Best Western Plus Kelowna Hotel & Suites; the phone number matches OSM exactly. The menu page includes explicit dietary filters for Vegetarian, Vegan, Gluten-Free, and Dairy-Free, and DoorDash delivery is advertised on the front page. No cycling-specific amenities — bike parking, water refill, or washrooms — are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM record has no physical address; address '2400 Hwy 97 North, Kelowna, BC V1X 4J1' sourced from website only — not cross-checkable against OSM.
Promotions page references 2023-dated events (Mother's Day 2023, a 'February–March' live entertainment run with no year), suggesting the website may not be actively maintained.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, operating pub and restaurant relevant to touring cyclists for food and drink, but none of the three required criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence. Recommend on-the-ground verification before including.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu page includes explicit dietary filters for Vegetarian, Vegetarian-modifiable, Vegan, Vegan-modifiable, Gluten-Free, Gluten-Free Available, Gluten-Free modifiable, and Dairy-Free options
